critical_issues: All core game logic files (game_logic.py, main.py, renderer.py) are empty placeholders, providing no executable code.
No input handling, tile movement, merging, random tile generation, scoring, or game‑over detection is implemented.
Without a main loop or rendering code, the program cannot be run or display anything.
judge.summary: The repository only contains a constants module defining visual parameters. All other required modules are empty placeholders, so none of the essential 2048 functionality is present. Consequently the submission fails to meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to be executable.
